description.value: Mahon Hall, officially Mahon Memorial Hall, is a beloved century-old landmark in the heart of Ganges village on Salt Spring Island, originally built in 1904 as an agricultural display hall and now home to the Salt Spring Arts Council. The hall hosts a busy calendar of concerts, theatrical performances, exhibitions, and community events, and has been a cultural anchor for the island for over a hundred years. Touring cyclists exploring Salt Spring Island — a popular cycling destination — may find it a worthwhile cultural stop in the village centre.
